zoe-sec: Heads-up: during a quick review of recent terraform merges, I noticed a partner onboarding PR that granted `roles/storage.objectAdmin` to a partner SA across the org. That role allows listing and reading blobs — some of which are KMS-wrapped vault artifacts. We should contain and coordinate rotation.

ben-infra: ouch. can you paste the binding and the service account?

zoe-sec: binding snippet: `members: - serviceAccount:svc-partner@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on resource `projects/redwood-prod`. PR id: #4521. Applied ~2h ago.

kevin-sre: immediate actions: 1) remove the IAM binding 2) revoke long-lived keys 3) enable/enhance Vault audit and forward to splunk for timeline 4) create a transient transit key for envelope-rotation of affected blobs.

anya-eng: do we know which buckets/blobs were enumerated? we have gsuite logs disabled for listing events historically.

audit-bot: Automated scan result: recent bucket access by svc-partner@partner-project detected at 1709600456; objects under `gs://artifacts-prod/enc-secrets/*` were accessed.

ben-infra: removing binding now: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member='serviceAccount:svc-partner@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/storage.objectAdmin'`

ops-bot: Job started: rbac-revoke-1709601111 status=running

kevin-sre: revoke any service-account keys for that account while we're at it: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-partner@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID` (disable first if you want).

ben-infra: keys disabled and two found; deleted both. `keys_deleted=2`

zoe-sec: enable Vault audit (if not on) and forward to splunk for real-time monitoring: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-partner-1709601111.log` then forward that file via our splunk-forwarder. Also enable HMAC option if available.

kevin-sre: enabling now. `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-partner-1709601111.log hmac_keys=...` i'll post the forwarder job id once started.

audit-bot: Splunk forwarder job started id=splunk-7781, tailing /var/log/vault/audit-partner-1709601111.log

anya-eng: about rotation: we don't want to rotate the org KEK immediately. proposal: create a per-incident transit key `incident-e2e-1709601111` and envelope-wrap the existing KMS ciphertexts so that unwrapping requires the new transit key + the original KMS. This buys time to audit which artifacts were actually read.

ben-infra: agree. creating transit key: `vault write -f transit/keys/incident-e2e-1709601111` followed by policy `incident-rewrap` that only allows `transit/encrypt` and `transit/decrypt` from our rewrap runner.

kevin-sre: we need a rewrap runner; I'll spin a short-lived job in k8s with a bound token (TTL 1h). runner will: list blob ids, for each blob download ciphertext to tmp, base64 encode ciphertext, call `vault write transit/encrypt/incident-e2e-1709601111 plaintext=<base64_ciphertext>` and store the returned ciphertext as the new envelope blob.

anya-eng: important: some blobs are already KMS-envelope encrypted and we cannot decrypt without KEK. The envelope-wrap approach (treat existing ciphertext as plaintext for the transit key) is correct. Documenting runbook snippet:```
# rewrap runner pseudocode
for blob in $(gsutil ls gs://artifacts-prod/enc-secrets/*); do
  gsutil cp $blob /tmp/blob.bin
  b64=$(base64 /tmp/blob.bin | tr -d '
')
  vault write transit/encrypt/incident-e2e-1709601111 plaintext=$b64 > /tmp/rewrap.out
  new_ct=$(jq -r .data.ciphertext /tmp/rewrap.out)
  echo $new_ct | base64 -d > /tmp/new_blob.bin
  gsutil cp /tmp/new_blob.bin $blob.incident1709601111
done
```

ben-infra: runner created: `rewrap-runner-1709601111` in namespace infra-incidents. Token posted into private runbook.

ops-bot: Job update: rbac-revoke-1709601111 status=done | keys_deleted=2 | binding_removed=true

zoe-sec: after envelope wrap, we should update Vault policies to deny direct read from the `enc-secrets` path by default for any non-privileged principals. Also create an allowlist for system services. Let's do a policy change: `path "secret/data/enc-secrets/*" { capabilities = ["read"] }` -> change to `deny` and route reads through a service that enforces audit and purpose.

kevin-sre: policy change applied in staging; will stage in prod with canary 5% before 100% rollout. Also adding an audit annotation policy to require request metadata for reads.

anya-eng: running the rewrap now; ETA ~15m. will post manifest to `gs://redwood-incident/1709601111/manifest.json` with checksums and original object names.

ben-infra: also pulled terraform state: the offending PR was caused by an overly-broad module variable; opened PR to tighten default to `roles/storage.objectViewer` instead of admin for partner onboards. tagging PR #4528.

ops-bot: Rewrap job started: rewrap-runner-1709601111 status=running blobs_found=18

kevin-sre: parallel task: enable Vault audit forwarding to our centralized GCS cold store for retention: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/incident-1709601111.log` then copy to `gs://redwood-audit-incident/1709601111/` nightly and lock retention.

Also, capture cloud KMS access logs (Cloud Audit Logs) for the time window. Requesting logs export to the incident bucket.

anya-eng: rewrap complete: rewraps_completed=18. uploaded manifest and checksums: `gs://redwood-incident/1709601111/manifest.json`. Posted MD5s.

audit-bot: Splunk events show `storage.objects.get` events for the SA between 1709599000 and 1709600500. No KMS key unwrapping events found in cloud audit logs (good).

zoe-sec: good signal. next steps: 1) rotate any long-lived KEKs if we see KMS Unwraps in audit 2) tighten onboarding terraform defaults and add PR checker to block `objectAdmin` 3) postmortem and partner notification draft for legal.

ben-infra: PR to update module and adding a terraform sentinel-like check in our CI: `ci/checks/deny-high-iam.sh` created.

kevin-sre: forensics: collecting vault audit, splunk events, cloud audit logs, and gsutil access times. Will post timeline in 48h.

ops-bot: Incident wrap: rbac-revoke-1709601111 status=contained rewraps_completed=18 keys_deleted=2 binding_removed=true followups: SEC-481, INFRA-2123, DEVEX-998

zoe-sec: thanks everyone. APs: ben - module + CI check, anya - manifest + rewrap verification, kevin - forensic timeline, me - partner/legal comms + postmortem. Update here when done. :thumbsup: 

anya-eng: verifying integrity checksums now, will confirm pass/fail in 30m.

kevin-sre: forensic artifacts tagged `incident:1709601111` and pushed to secure bucket. starting deeper timeline work.
